requirements.text: The system should allow students to check the availability of materials and manage loans online, including borrowing and returning items without needing to visit the desk.
Students should receive email reminders a few days before items are due, as well as immediate notifications when fines are added to their accounts.
Librarians must have the ability to easily add and update inventory items, track availability, and generate usage reports to understand checkout trends.
The system should provide librarians with tools to manage student accounts, including placing holds on accounts with outstanding fines.
The design of the system must support the personal service currently provided at the desk, ensuring that staff can still offer assistance for questions and issues.
